data: {"data":[{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"exteh6ue0d1v6k2t90u8kqda","label":"Cave of the Dragon Skull","content":"As the party ascended the mountainside, they reached a cave carved into the rock, resembling a massive dragon skull. The gaping maw of the skull exhaled blasts of hot steam every few seconds, the heat intense enough to singe nearby foliage. \"Praise the sun, a sauna!\" Gideon Xander exclaimed. E.t. Skittles noted the ominous nature of the cave, questioning if it was a trap or merely an obstacle. Recognizing this as the dragon's lair, the adventurers prepared for what lay ahead as they stood before the entrance.","image":null,"index":38,"categories":["Exploration","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"fk8tnebdpzewmoagbf9fumhl","label":"E.t. Skittles Inspects the Dragon-Head Medallion","content":"As E.t. Skittles examined the Dragon-Head Medallion, he noticed that its edges were intricately shaped, suggesting they were designed to fit into a larger mechanism. The group had been investigating the area, with Dookeldorn Bludvart questioning if there was more to explore. E.t. had previously mentioned the significance of the dragon, leading to a discussion about the arrangement of various tablets they had found. E.t. declared, \"I think I know how to solve this puzzle,\" indicating his understanding of the connection between the medallion and the mysterious door they were trying to unlock. The party prepared to piece together the clues before them.","image":null,"index":45,"categories":["Discovery","Intrigue"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"i1d0morliza09ij09atszikq","label":"Gideon Xander's Negotiation with Haldraxis","content":"As Gideon Xander approached the imposing dragon Haldraxis, he declared, \"I have no gold for you. But what I do have is a kindier? We should talk.\" Haldraxis narrowed his sharp orange eyes and retorted, \"You've kept me waiting for this is the third day. I hope you've brought my gold.\" Gideon pressed on, questioning the dragon's motives and suggesting, \"Let's talk about other ways you can get gold. This doesn't seem you. Seems something's wrong here.\" The tension hung in the air as Gideon attempted to steer the conversation away from gold and towards understanding Haldraxis's true desires.","image":null,"index":35,"categories":["Negotiation","Intrigue"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"juebjiceccpny6gu8pzgdqx4","label":"E.t. Skittles Strikes the Mountain Giants","content":"E.t. Skittles swung his greatclub, delivering a powerful blow to the Mountain Giants, who staggered under the impact. The giant, already bleeding from various wounds, felt the weight of the strike and looked defeated. As E.t. turned to face Gideon Xander, the giant's expression reflected a mix of rage and despair, having been thwarted in his attempts to ensnare the adventurers with a trap he had worked on. The giant's resolve began to crumble under the relentless pressure of the heroes' onslaught.","image":null,"index":42,"categories":["Combat","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"n27y4ji4zqycp8feg0ehavq1","label":"Stealthy Doorway Revelation","content":"Bronn Boromir stealthily cracked open the northwest door, supported by Gideon Xander, revealing a cluttered Workshop. Inside, a Mountain Giants was working on a metal contraption, focused entirely on the task at hand and oblivious to the intruders. The room was filled with tables and workbenches, all covered in various designs and half-finished projects, while steam escaped through a hole in the ceiling. As Bronn peered in, he noticed the giant's high-strung demeanor, likely due to the sounds of creatures outside the cave. Gideon cast a spell to create a shower of sparks on the workbench, aiming to distract the giant further.","image":null,"index":41,"categories":["Intrigue","Discovery"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"q6o5mydlmgbxkz0x3inemaug","label":"Haldraxis Takes Flight Amidst Chaos","content":"As Haldraxis prepared to take off, E.t. Skittles clawed at the dragon's hindquarters, attempting to hinder its escape. Bronn Boromir swung his greatclub, striking Haldraxis with a powerful blow. Dookeldorn Bludvart shot at the dragon again, shouting, \"Don't forget your gold!\" The dragon, realizing it was being bested by the adventurers, fanned out its leathery wings and launched into the air, prompting opportunity attacks from the party. The air crackled with tension as the adventurers fought to keep the dragon grounded, their strikes echoing in the desert sky.","image":null,"index":37,"categories":["Conflict","Combat"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"qdo995jgfx9cjulr6qh0yizc","label":"Bronn Boromir's Telekinetic Takedown of the Giant","content":"As Bronn Boromir emerged from the fog, he spotted the giant preparing to leap from the cave with a rustic rock snowboard. He shouted, \"Nice try, asshole!\" and unleashed his telekinetic ability, aiming to shove the giant off balance. The giant, caught off guard, stumbled as Bronn's psychic force hit him, sending him tumbling down the mountain. The giant's surprised expression was evident as he lost his footing, unable to mount the snowboard correctly. Bronn stood at the cave's edge, watching the giant's chaotic descent.","image":null,"index":44,"categories":["Conflict","Victory"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"txjcq3g1kazsb56oysx47nlt","label":"Gideon Xander's Green Dragon Cleanup","content":"Gideon Xander approached the altar and spotted fresh green dragon dung nearby. With a shovel from his camping gear, he began scooping it up, muttering, \"Naughty dragon. Leave only take only pictures. Leave only footprints.\" E.t. Skittles, seeing the opportunity, insisted, \"You can't take all this good stuff on your own. They call this black gold in the hell!\" As Gideon helped E.t. fill his shell with the dung, E.t. remarked, \"That's even better because it just matches my shell,\" while pretending to stuff the dung into imaginary pockets. Gideon joked about the delusion of pockets, making the cleanup a bizarre endeavor.","image":null,"index":32,"categories":["Hijinx","Banter"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"uw87doihyudctrb4esl1vthl","label":"Gideon Xander's Healing Touch","content":"As the giant swung his greatclub, E.t. Skittles felt the impact of the blow, exclaiming, \"It hurts. I don't it.\" The giant, visibly defeated, turned to face Gideon Xander, who rushed forward. Gideon took E.t.'s head in his hands and implored, \"My son, the light is calling. Lay down your weapon.\" The giant complied, putting down his club, allowing Gideon to heal E.t. and bring him back to his feet, ready to continue the confrontation.","image":null,"index":43,"categories":["Heroism","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"wk18j8dyu8yipotyi0060p3h","label":"Gideon Xander's Prayer and E.t. Skittles's Disguise","content":"Gideon Xander stood near the altar, arms raised in prayer, thanking the heavenly orb for cleansing his bowels. He sang hymns to the sun, fully exposed and unaware of the impending arrival of the dragon. Meanwhile, E.t. Skittles hid at a distance, preparing to don an improvised disguise as a female dragon, intending to woo the creature. He expressed his intention to remain hidden, acknowledging that while Gideon was bold, he preferred to stay out of sight, away from the altar and the traps set for the dragon.","image":null,"index":33,"categories":["Hijinx","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"wlprz6c42012yqwehvs05sn3","label":"The Dragon-Head Medallion Unlocks the Door","content":"After much deliberation, the party arranged the three circular tablets into the correct order, with the Dragon-Head Medallion placed prominently at the top. Dookeldorn Bludvart flipped the two remaining tablets, while Bronn Boromir and E.t. Skittles provided suggestions about the arrangement. Gideon Xander declared the order, asserting that the head should be at the top and the tail at the bottom. As they completed the arrangement, the stone door began to rumble ominously, signaling that their efforts had succeeded. With a final push, the door creaked open, revealing what lay beyond.","image":null,"index":46,"categories":["Discovery","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"xgrx6kbguex7ak27975lc9xq","label":"Haldraxis' Vengeful Claw","content":"Haldraxis lunged forward, his claws glinting in the light as he swiped at Dookeldorn Bludvart, landing a powerful blow that sent him sprawling to the ground. \"The humans will pay!\" the young red dragon roared, his voice echoing with fury. The attack left Dookeldorn prone as Haldraxis prepared for his next move.","image":null,"index":36,"categories":["Conflict","Combat"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:23:05.505000","updated_at":null,"id":"dip6lbn22j873hryspwfxfri","label":"E.t. Skittles's Dragon Disguise Attempt","content":"As the party deliberated their route to Old Temple Ruins, E.t. Skittles smeared mud across his turtle body and searched for red berries to crush and dye his skin, attempting to create a dragon disguise. He etched patterns into the mud to mimic scales. His efforts achieved a level of effectiveness that surprised his companions, who remarked on the quality of his artistic endeavor. The group chuckled at the sight of E.t. as he prepared for the challenges ahead.","image":null,"index":21,"categories":["Hijinx","Chaos"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7lhkb00000aj8tv2kz4d5"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:23:05.505000","updated_at":null,"id":"e2h2pq6g952as3093c4uqx4d","label":"E.t. Skittles and the Dragon Bounty","content":"E.t. Skittles, a large turtle-like man, approached the bar where a distressed man in a ceremonial guard outfit revealed that a dragon had attacked Byriver. The guard, desperate for help, offered a reward of three hundred gold pieces for the dragon's defeat, emphasizing the urgency of the situation. E.t. engaged in a humorous exchange with the guard, who lamented his inability to connect with the youth of the city to recruit adventurers. The guard expressed his dire need for strong allies to confront the dragon, while E.t. suggested he could help.","image":null,"index":17,"categories":["Conflict","Betrayal"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7lhkb00000aj8tv2kz4d5"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:23:05.505000","updated_at":null,"id":"eqcag0vz66iqqfrz9ciyq6lz","label":"Teamwork Against the Mountain Giant","content":"As the group crested a hill, Gideon Xander and Bronn Boromir spotted a mountain giant encampment nestled in the valley below. Gideon commanded the party to flee, but E.t. Skittles countered with a powerful Guiding Bolt aimed at the giant. The bolt struck true, illuminating the giant in radiant light, prompting the creature to bellow in anger and retreat from the area.","image":null,"index":24,"categories":["Conflict","Victory"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7lhkb00000aj8tv2kz4d5"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:23:05.505000","updated_at":null,"id":"f0tszhirrvj6vsrm8hdtjcr7","label":"Dookeldorn Bludvart's Heartfelt Tale of Loss","content":"Dookeldorn Bludvart recounted the loss of his brother during a dragon attack, explaining that he had been part of a mercenary group tasked with confronting the beast named Hadraxas. He described the night of the attack, detailing how he had stepped away to relieve himself when chaos erupted. \"I lost my brother; he's gone. I assume he's dead,\" he stated. The AC girls listened intently, their expressions shifting to sympathy as they recognized the weight of his loss. Dookeldorn concluded, \"You guys have really pulled me out of a real tough spot,\" acknowledging the comfort he found in their company.","image":null,"index":18,"categories":["Loss","Friendship"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7lhkb00000aj8tv2kz4d5"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:23:05.505000","updated_at":null,"id":"jcr5jyy4yb73oaaiohkoyjvl","label":"Turning Anger into Faith","content":"While working at the bar, Gideon Xander approached an angry guest named Ron Thunderbrew after accidentally spilling a drink. Gideon offered Ron a handwritten pamphlet about his faith in Lathander, but Ron crumpled it up and tossed it behind the bar. Gideon reassured Ron, saying, \"He said he'll look at them eventually. They're there; he doesn't throw them away. They're always there.\" Despite Ron's skepticism, Gideon engaged in a conversation that aimed to connect over shared beliefs. He left Ron with another pamphlet.","image":null,"index":15,"categories":["Friendship","Negotiation"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7lhkb00000aj8tv2kz4d5"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:23:05.505000","updated_at":null,"id":"krc2fpom2vgkdd52dnmc31gx","label":"Harvesting Magical Ice Flowers","content":"As the party trudged along a treacherous icy path, they stumbled upon a small meadow filled with blue-white flowers, their petals cold to the touch. Bronn Boromir recognized the flowers as Magical Ice Flowers with magical properties and shared his knowledge with the group. Dookeldorn Bludvart, eager to test their safety, carefully harvested one flower and found nothing amiss. Encouraged by this, he proceeded to gather several handfuls, securing a total of twenty-six intact flowers for later use.","image":null,"index":22,"categories":["Discovery","Loot"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7lhkb00000aj8tv2kz4d5"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:23:05.505000","updated_at":null,"id":"pvme0wxjfee5zwwrkl3dhlju","label":"Dookeldorn Bludvart Leads the Ascent to the Temple Ruins","content":"With the looming threat of the dragon, Dookeldorn Bludvart took the lead, urging the group to take the Mountain Route to the temple ruins. \"We have two days to get there before the dragon shows up,\" he declared. The others, including Gideon Xander and Bronn Boromir, acknowledged the tight timeline and prepared to act swiftly. As they set off, each step brought them closer to the ruins and the dragon that awaited them. The journey was fraught with tension, but Dookeldorn's determination pushed them onward.","image":null,"index":23,"categories":["Conflict","Heroism"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7lhkb00000aj8tv2kz4d5"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:23:05.505000","updated_at":null,"id":"rrt797du6gcu7q1rxf4m2gen","label":"Philip's Urgent Briefing on Haldraxis","content":"As the group gathered, Philip began to share crucial information about the red dragon Haldraxis. He explained that Haldraxis, while not an elder dragon, posed a significant threat with his fire breath and had issued demands for a golden horde to be delivered by the river. Philip revealed that if the payment was not made by the end of the fourth day, the dragon would unleash destruction upon the countryside. He handed each adventurer a map to Old Temple Ruins where Haldraxis would wait, urging them to act quickly to catch the dragon off guard. Dominic suggested that instead of violence, they might negotiate with the dragon, prompting a discussion among the group about their approach to the impending confrontation.","image":null,"index":20,"categories":["Conflict","Negotiation"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7lhkb00000aj8tv2kz4d5"}],"total":45,"page":2,"size":20,"pages":3}
